new_claim.title: Full formal stationary-ball frame and leading-coefficient seed obstruction for one-variable polynomial phases
new_claim.scope: Let K=C((r)),phi in K[x] have arbitrary degree D>=2 with leading coefficient a_D,and h in K nonzero. On M=K[x]/(partial_x+phi_x)K[x],with connection partial_r+phi_r+h_prime/h,a finite Puiseux ramification gives a FULL rank-one formal exponential frame. Critical roots form disjoint intrinsic balls;each contributes deg(F_B)-1 dimensions. A finite cluster-tree polynomial separator gives an invertible complete evaluation matrix even at colliding,multiple and escaping critical points. Every zero-exponential frame functional on seed[1] has valuation>=v(h)-v(a_D)/D. Consequently D*v(h)>v(a_D) excludes any horizontal quotient of the differential seed submodule taking seed to1. For rational phases this excludes even a formal Gaussian seed1 at another point,by rational restriction to the differential seed submodule;no full image-kernel or actual-period realization is needed. Equality is not enough:phi=-x^2/(2t^2),h=1/t has constant normalized Gaussian period. The proof permits ARBITRARY NONCONVERGENT FORMAL Laurent coefficients over this valued field;it is NOT an arbitrary-ring descent statement. Cubic applications give an alternative fully written proof that P=W(a+bZ+cT+fT^2)+G, f!=0,degG<=3,is pure iff b=0,G=0 (cutoff m>degQ),including the flattened quadratic boundary,and exclude every W(a+T+Z^2)+G. These close standalone-paper obligation PAPER-B-R and shorten the mixed proof;PAPER-B-L logarithmic punctures and PAPER-A geometric no-frame consolidation remain OPEN in the manuscript. Classical Newton-Puiseux and formal stationary phase are credited to the cited Wall/Sabbah background,without equating this construction to Sabbah Theorem5.1 or claiming priority. Finite exact controls do not prove the written completeness,horizontality or semisimplicity. No independent replay,formal verification,external review,novelty assessment or complete-paper claim.
